why: issue 2056: a nano-ros convenience on the value object, not in upstream's `ParameterValue` (which reads through `get<T>()` only; upstream's `as_*` are on `Parameter`). `rclcpp::Parameter`'s `as_*` forward to these, and a freestanding build has the scalar ones.
